evals.prompt: I want to embed pi-excalidraw inside an Obsidian pane so I do not need a separate browser tab. What architecture should I use?
evals.expected_output: Recommends an Obsidian custom view wrapper around the existing localhost runtime, explains why iframe-first is the best first step, and separates view, runtime, and vault concerns.

evals.prompt: How should an Obsidian plugin handle MCP elicitation for note creation, file rename approval, and OAuth login?
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes form-mode and URL-mode elicitation, maps form-mode to native modals, maps URL-mode to external browser plus waiting state, and adds trust-tiered approval guidance for vault writes.

evals.prompt: Sketch the folder structure and first implementation slice for an Obsidian plugin that hosts MCP Apps and a localhost-backed Excalidraw UI.
evals.expected_output: Provides a concrete plugin scaffold with main.ts, views, services, settings, and safe phased implementation guidance rather than an overbuilt all-at-once design.
